description: Search YouTubers with advanced filters: subscribers, language, niches, sponsors worked with, monthly frequency, etc. All filters combine with AND — including hasWorkedWith, which keeps only creators who worked with EVERY listed domain. For "worked with brand A OR brand B", run one search per brand (or use sponsor_youtubers). Returns compact results. Use youtuber_get for full detail.

hasNotWorkedWith.description: Exclude YouTubers who worked with ANY of these sponsor website domains (max 10)

hasWorkedWith.description: Sponsor website domains (e.g. "nordvpn.com"). AND filter: the creator must have worked with ALL of them, so each extra domain narrows the results (max 10). Not an OR: for "any of these brands", run one search per brand.

name: youtuber_search
